dataset_scope.option_history_kind: Dhan rolling ATM-relative options, not every possible historical strike/contract
dataset_scope.historical_greeks: Not supplied by historical rolling API. Black-Scholes European Greeks are derived from sourced expiry/rate/dividend inputs when available; otherwise separately labelled proxy Greeks use rule-derived NIFTY expiry and explicit zero-rate/zero-dividend assumptions. Proxy/source status and assumptions are carried per row. Current option-chain Greeks are never backfilled. Dhan's numeric IV units are not stated in the reviewed schema, so normalized-IV Greeks also carry an explicit versioned heuristic: values >3 are treated as percentage points and divided by 100; values <=3 are treated as fractional IV.

budgets.retry_policy: One retry only for network timeout/429/5xx, max 100 retries total; no redirect, no auth/schema/other 4xx retry; when budget is exhausted record failure and continue remaining requests

output.greeks: Source-based Black-Scholes Greeks when point-in-time expiry/rate/dividend inputs exist; otherwise visibly labelled proxy Greeks with expiry_mapping_source, risk_free_rate_source, dividend_yield_source, greek_assumption, greek_status. If expiry cannot be mapped, Greek values remain null. Source and proxy rows are countable separately. Every Greek row also discloses the IV normalization heuristic, because the provider's documented field schema does not specify the numeric IV unit.

provenance_rules: Raw response bytes and hashes immutable within cache; exact request body and request ID persisted separately
Validate JSON, array lengths, timestamps, provider request window, row/byte budget and duplicate source keys
Never reconcile/correct Dhan values against NSE/third-party market-price values; the user waived that requirement
Join spot OHLCV by exact epoch timestamp; retain rolling endpoint spot in separate column
Only use real source/contract/calendar inputs for actual expiry; no expiry-date fabrication

Derive source-based Black-Scholes Greeks when point-in-time expiry/rate/dividend inputs exist; otherwise only separately labelled proxy Greeks may use rule-derived expiry dates and explicit zero-rate/zero-dividend assumptions with source/assumption columns; leave Greek values null with a reason code if expiry cannot be mapped. The IV unit assumption is recorded on every Greek row.
Missing source affects only its rows/feature family; continue other request IDs and report missing coverage
Output encrypted monthly CSV parts only as Actions artifacts for user download; do not publish paid/subscription market rows as plaintext in public repository assets.

cache.reuse: Verify source request key, response hash, byte count, row/schema invariants before treating a cache hit as valid; only missing/invalid planned requests are fetched.
cache.storage_policy: Raw subscribed market data are never committed in plaintext to this public repository. Raw payloads and CSV parts are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM; reusable encrypted shards and the cumulative request ledger are carried in the encrypted GitHub Actions cache, subject to Actions cache retention/eviction. The user-downloadable artifact contains encrypted monthly CSV parts plus manifest and coverage report.

data_safety.encryption: AES-256-GCM with random per-object nonce; key derived from runtime-only HF_TOKEN secret using scrypt
data_safety.user_offline_decryption: requires same HF_TOKEN value used to encrypt the artifact; token itself is never included in files or logs

scope_note: Dataset covers the provider-supported ATM-relative rolling-grid selection, not every historical option contract or strike. Historical Dhan price values are accepted without an external value cross-check as directed by the user.
